sections.guidance: Primary page headline. 5-10 words. Introduce the news and events hub.

sections.label: Hero Subtitle
sections.guidance: Supporting line. 10-20 words. Set expectations for what visitors will find.

sections.label: Featured Heading
sections.guidance: Section headline. 3-8 words. Highlight featured content.

sections.label: Archive Heading
sections.guidance: Section headline. 3-8 words. Introduce the archive list.

sections.label: Events Heading
sections.guidance: Section headline. 3-8 words. Introduce upcoming events.

sections.label: Events Card 2 Body
sections.guidance: Placeholder or message for when no more events are listed. 10-20 words.

sections.label: Newsletter Heading
sections.guidance: CTA headline for newsletter signup. 5-10 words.

sections.label: Newsletter Body
sections.guidance: Supporting text for newsletter signup. 15-25 words.

sections.label: Header Headline
sections.guidance: Article headline. 5-15 words. Clear, newsworthy, informative.

sections.label: Image Caption
sections.guidance: Caption for the hero image. 5-15 words. Describe what is shown.

sections.label: Body Heading 1
sections.guidance: First subheading within the article. 3-8 words.

sections.label: Body Paragraph 1
sections.guidance: First body paragraph. 40-80 words. Lead with the key news.

sections.label: Body Paragraph 2
sections.guidance: Second body paragraph. 40-80 words. Expand with context or detail.

sections.label: Body Pullquote
sections.guidance: Featured quote or key statement pulled from the article. 15-30 words.

sections.label: Body Paragraph 3
sections.guidance: Third body paragraph. 40-80 words. Continue the story.

sections.label: Body Paragraph 5
sections.guidance: Final body paragraph. 40-80 words. Wrap up or look ahead.

sections.label: Share Label
sections.guidance: Label for social sharing links. e.g. 'Share this article'. 2-4 words.

sections.label: Hero Headline
sections.guidance: Event name. 5-15 words. Clear and descriptive.

sections.label: Hero Date Label
sections.guidance: Label for the date field. e.g. 'Date'. 1 word.

sections.label: Hero Time Label
sections.guidance: Label for the time field. Include timezone. e.g. 'Time (ACST)'. Type 'All Day' in the value field for multi-day events.

sections.label: Hero Time Value
sections.guidance: Event time in Adelaide HQ timezone. e.g. '2:00 PM - 3:00 PM'. Or 'All Day' for conferences.

sections.label: Hero Local Time Label
sections.guidance: Label for the dynamic local time. e.g. 'Your Time'. Dev will make this dynamic.

sections.label: Hero Local Time Value
sections.guidance: Placeholder for dynamic local time. Dev will replace with browser-calculated time.

sections.label: Hero Location Label
sections.guidance: Label for the location field. e.g. 'Location'. 1 word.

sections.label: Hero Location Value
sections.guidance: Event location. Venue name and city. 3-10 words.

sections.label: Details Heading
sections.guidance: Section heading for event details. 2-5 words. e.g. 'About This Event'.

sections.label: Details Paragraph 1
sections.guidance: First paragraph about the event. 40-80 words. What it is and why it matters.

sections.label: Details Paragraph 2
sections.guidance: Second paragraph. 40-80 words. Additional context or agenda highlights.

sections.label: Speaker 1 Role
sections.guidance: Speaker's title and organisation. e.g. 'CEO, Chrysos Corporation'.

sections.label: Speaker 1 Bio
sections.guidance: Short biography. 2-4 sentences covering credentials and relevance. Leave empty to hide dropdown.

sections.label: Speaker 2 Bio
sections.guidance: Short biography. 2-4 sentences. Leave empty to hide dropdown.

sections.label: Speaker 3 Bio
sections.guidance: Short biography. 2-4 sentences. Leave empty to hide dropdown.

sections.label: Speaker 4 Bio
sections.guidance: Short biography. 2-4 sentences. Leave empty to hide dropdown.

sections.label: Audience Heading
sections.guidance: Section heading. 2-5 words. e.g. 'Who Should Attend'.

sections.label: Audience Item 1
sections.guidance: Target audience type. 3-8 words. e.g. 'Mine site operations managers'.

sections.label: Form Heading
sections.guidance: Registration form heading. 3-8 words. e.g. 'Register Your Interest'.

sections.label: Form Label First Name
sections.guidance: Form field label. e.g. 'First Name'. 1-3 words.

sections.label: Form Label Last Name
sections.guidance: Form field label. e.g. 'Last Name'. 1-3 words.

sections.label: Form Label Email
sections.guidance: Form field label. e.g. 'Email Address'. 1-3 words.

sections.label: Form Label Role
sections.guidance: Form field label. e.g. 'Job Title'. 1-3 words.

sections.label: Form Submit Button
sections.guidance: Button text. 2-4 words, action-oriented. e.g. 'Register Now'.

sections.label: Back Link
sections.guidance: Link text to return to the events listing. 2-5 words.
